articles.title: Moon Mission Makeover: Astronauts Will Test Space Docking, Not Walk on the Moon!
articles.summary: NASA's Artemis III won't land on the Moon after all. Instead, astronauts will orbit Earth and practice docking with lunar landers. Commander Randy Bresnik leads the crew. A recent rocket explosion at Blue Origin made things even trickier.

articles.title: Sweden Says 'Hej då' to Phones in Class!
articles.summary: Starting this fall, Sweden will ban mobile phones in all schools. The government wants kids to read more books and use fewer screens. Many students already put their phones in a 'Mobile Hotel' during class and say it helps them focus.

articles.title: Friendship on the Rocks? Trump and Netanyahu Clash Over War and Peace
articles.summary: President Trump and Israel's Prime Minister Netanyahu are arguing about war with Iran. Trump wants a peace deal, but Netanyahu may want to keep fighting. Experts say their friendship is cracking because their goals are now very different.
